caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a dark, almost black ceramic vessel that appears to be a type of pitcher or jug with a wide, rounded body, a pronounced spout, and a looped handle. The vessel sits on a small, slightly elevated circular base. Its surface shows highlights and subtle shading that suggest a glossy or polished finish, with lighter grayish areas indicating reflections or light spots. The background is a plain, unadorned off-white or beige color, and there are no other objects or decorative elements present in the image. The vessel is centered both horizontally and vertically within the composition. There is a small, neat signature below the pitcher toward the right side.
title: Moravian Pitcher
